newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil steelmakers upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil steelmakers upgraded.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming Inc said it upgraded Brazilian steel firms CSN, to buy from long-term buy, and Cosipa, to buy from speculative buy.

-- It said in a report that CSN should benefit from a cost-reduction program over the next two years. It also said, "CSN has a unique opportunity in the global steel industry to integrate costs in related activities resulting from the privatizations in Brazil."
-- Regarding Cosipa, the report said the recent approval by Brazil's antitrust agency of Usiminas's acquisition of Cosipa "should be the trigger to drive Cosipa's share price up even further."
-- "Even after rallying 55.3 percent since our last Speculative Buy recommendation, Cosipa is still an extremely cheap stock," it said.
-- CSN stock was flat at 28.30 reais and Cosipa preferred was flat at 0.84 reais in morning trade on the Sao Paulo bourse.
